svg.title: Five sealed bids look identical before drand round R; after R anyone opens them and the clearing price is public.
svg.text: The same five bids, before and after the opening

g.text: BEFORE ROUND R · every bid is a sealed memo on the same fixed deposit
AFTER ROUND R · anyone opens every bid; the rules set one price
2 units for sale → the two highest bids win and both pay the lowest winning price, 380
same size, same memo length, shielded: nothing on chain says which bid is high
